=== FILE: pipeline_manager.py ===
"""Deployment pipeline lifecycle state manager."""
from typing import Set, Dict, Any
from errors import ServiceError
from pipeline_models import PipelineEntity

ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {
    "PENDING": {"BUILDING", "CANCELLED"},
    "BUILDING": {"TESTING", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"},
    "TESTING": {"DEPLOYED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"},
    "DEPLOYED": set(),
    "FAILED": set(),
    "CANCELLED": set(),
}

def transition_pipeline(pipeline: PipelineEntity, new_state: str, actor_id: str, timestamp_ms: int) -> None:
    """Transitions pipeline to target state and records audit event."""
    old_state = pipeline.state
    
    # Validate allowed transitions
    if new_state not in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(old_state, set()):
        raise ServiceError(
            code="ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION",
            message=f"Invalid state transition from {old_state} to {new_state}"
        )
    
    # Record audit tuple before changing state
    audit_tuple = ("STATE_TRANSITION", pipeline.entity_id, old_state, new_state, actor_id, timestamp_ms)
    pipeline.audit_trail.append(audit_tuple)
    
    # Update state
    pipeline.state = new_state

def get_pipeline_status(pipeline: PipelineEntity) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"id": pipeline.entity_id, "state": pipeline.state, "terminal": pipeline.is_terminal()}
=== END ===
=== FILE: tests/test_pipeline_cases.py ===
import pytest
from pipeline_models import PipelineEntity
from pipeline_manager import transition_pipeline, get_pipeline_status
from errors import ServiceError

def test_case_1():
    # Test that illegal transitions raise appropriate error and don't update state
    p = PipelineEntity("pipe-001")
    assert p.state == "PENDING"
    
    # Try illegal transition
    with pytest.raises(ServiceError) as excinfo:
        transition_pipeline(p, "DEPLOYED", "actor-1", 1700000000000)
    
    assert excinfo.value.code == "ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION"
    assert p.state == "PENDING"  # State should not have changed
    assert p.audit_count() == 0  # No audit record should have been added

def test_case_2():
    # Test that legal transitions work correctly and record audit trail
    p = PipelineEntity("pipe-001")
    assert p.state == "PENDING"
    
    # Perform legal transition
    transition_pipeline(p, "BUILDING", "actor-1", 1700000000000)
    assert p.state == "BUILDING"
    assert p.audit_count() == 1
    
    # Check audit record
    audit_record = p.audit_trail[0]
    assert audit_record[0] == "STATE_TRANSITION"
    assert audit_record[1] == "pipe-001"
    assert audit_record[2] == "PENDING"
    assert audit_record[3] == "BUILDING"
    assert audit_record[4] == "actor-1"
    assert audit_record[5] == 1700000000000
=== END ===
